title: Second post leaves rent_increase_notice_view's hand-pinned Q1 cross-link as an untracked, now-quarter-stale series surface
evidence: rent_increase_notice_view.gleam:35: `const dublin_rents_path: String = "/resources/dublin-rents-q1-2026"`; :269: `layout.inline_link(dublin_rents_path, "Dublin rents, Q1 2026"),`. Diff adds `pub const posts: List(RentPost) = [dublin_q2_2026, dublin_q1_2026]`, making Q2 (published_iso 2026-08-24) the newest post. Registry header enumerates its surfaces: "Surfacing is explicit (not via `content_pages.pages`): the sitemap, the `/resources` \"Rent data\" hub section, and one stable footer link" — this link is not among them; layout.gleam footer uses `footer_link("/resources#rent-data", "Rent reports")`.
detail: Every quarterly release must now remember to bump this out-of-registry slug-and-label by hand, and nothing (test, registry, hub) tracks it. The link is honest (labels Q1; Q1 stays live), so note not warning.
recommended_fix: Retarget `dublin_rents_path` at `/resources#rent-data` with a quarter-free label, or derive the newest slug from `rent_post.posts` instead of pinning Q1.
